imputation.cap_basis: arm x calendar month (MM), pooled over years

restated.formulas: SE = 1.07*sigma/sqrt(n); MDE80 = 3.340*SE; power = Phi(0.0057/SE - 2.498); futility false-stop = 1 - Phi(0.00285/(sigma/sqrt(n_look))); sigma_hat thresholds = SE_thr*sqrt(n)/1.07

rulings.RULING_V10_GZ_FCOMMENT_FEXTRA: any FCOMMENT or FEXTRA on any .gz is a hit (m-1), dated tokens counted on top
rulings.RULING_V11_NBM_ROLLOVER: build only: valid_time_utc at a row's top level in nbm_market_new/nbm_pit_corpus_rows.jsonl or pool_nbm_rows.jsonl; literal Y26_PRE0527, local date <= 2025-12-31 in the pinned row tz, instant <= V11_INSTANT_LAST (noon UTC of the first day of that year); counted; byte side cuts the exact spans
rulings.RULING_V12_V11_REVIEW: ruling texts hold no guard-range date; v11 tz must equal the bound parser's station tz where it has one (counted, pinned); the allowance fires only for a dict row at the JSONL line root, rows are walked one by one in the Writer and at stage end, a non-dict line is a hit
rulings.RULING_V7_DECISION_ALLOWANCE: whole value equals a pinned r0_scope constant; counted
rulings.RULING_V8_M1_RECORDS_BYTES: whole-span cuts: own centre label(s), own generated_at, decision constants; then 0
rulings.RULING_V8_M2_PANDAS_SURFACES: index, columns, name, names, attrs, every MultiIndex level, every category
rulings.RULING_V8_RECORDS_IDENTITY: sha256 of the decompressed payload; raw sha256 cross-checked with gzip MTIME masked
rulings.RULING_V9_GZ_HEADERS: every member's FNAME/FCOMMENT/FEXTRA scanned raw; only a records file's own tmp FNAME passes

v5_gate_section7.obs_rule: last WU observation at or before 07:00 local on the date
